name: Tachibana Yukino
source:
She is the most talented student in her grade, with excellent grades, and is admired by everyone. But in fact, she is an otaku girl who loves cosplay. 

Since she shared her secret with the protagonist, she has become friends with the main character, becoming the only person to whom she can be herself.

[Translated from [url=http://www.ole-m.net/products/saimin_wonderful/character_a.html#character_a]official website[/url]]
